source: The paper reports that keys exhibit channel-wise outlier structure, motivating per-channel key quantization, while values are better handled per-token. KIVI combines these choices in a tuning-free asymmetric 2-bit KV-cache method and retains a small residual region in higher precision for recent tokens in its practical implementation.
zh: 该论文报告称，密钥表现出通道方式的异常结构，从而激发了每个通道的密钥量化，而每个令牌的值可以得到更好的处理。 KIVI 将这些选择结合在免调整的非对称 2 位 KV 缓存方法中，并在实际实现中为最近的令牌以更高的精度保留了一个小的残留区域。
